title: Semi-Precious Metal
html:
Quest Giver: Sam 'Dog Walker'

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Recover the 'Semi-Precious Metal' notes from KrypKogulous the emotional heavy metal singer in Cryptacular.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sam 'Dog Walker'

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Lovely Little Bumps

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Recover the 'Semi-Precious Metal' notes from KrypKogulous the emotional heavy metal singer in Cryptacular.

Offer:

The King's Bishop's Knight's Stable boy was sure in a foul mood. It appears that his almost townston famous collection of semi-precious metal notes, recently went missing. He was at first of course afraid that he had used them to shoe a horse, but then he remembered that there are no horses in Townston. Because of that...

Well anyways, the Townston commander noticed a flyer advertizing a new monster singer was going to be playing in Cryptacular, and that the type of music was emotional semi-precious metal. This of course throws up an orange flag to the stable boy, and he sure got angry at the dirt on his shoe.

Anyways... Why don't you go down to Cryptacular and see if KrypKogulous really did take the Stable Boy's semi-precious metal notes. If he did, bring them back to me for a reward.

I, Sam, the King's Bishop's Knight's Stable Boy's dog walker will be here at Balzack's Base Camp waiting to hear from you.

Turn-in:

Those no good monsters, not only are they corrupting their own kind with this un-holy dance and music they are not stealing from the good citizens of Townston. This makes me so furious. I should raise an army of semi-leathal attack dogs and let them loose in the dungeons!.

Objectives:

  • KrypKogulous
  • Semi-Precious Metal Notes ×1

Level range: 55–100
